analysis: The item-bias candidate failed the host’s post-training correctness check: forward added learned item biases, while the host requires positive training scores to equal the tied-embedding dot product exactly. Zero initialization does not preserve that equality after training. Observed validation HR@10 peaked at 0.640 at epoch 10, below the supplied parent’s 0.645; no improvement was demonstrated. The run completed 30 training epochs but crashed during final checking, so it was not a valid completed submission. Future candidates must preserve the host’s dot-product scoring contract.
code_summary: Causal NextItNet with 64-dimensional tied item embeddings, eight independent residual blocks, and dilations [1,2,4,8,1,2,4,8]. Each block gates between local and dilated kernel-3 convolutions, then applies a second dilated convolution, with LayerNorm, GELU, dropout, and learned per-channel residual scales initialized to 0.1. Padding is masked after every block; candidate scoring selects the last nonpadding state. No positional embeddings. This candidate added zero-initialized per-item biases after backbone initialization to both training and candidate scores. Constants remained MAXLEN=128, DROPOUT_RATE=0.2, LR=0.001, WEIGHT_DECAY=0.0, and BATCH_SIZE=128.
